papers.title: View-Dependent Deformation for 2.5-D Cartoon Models
papers.adaptation: Reuse the existing trigonometric cardinal basis through yaw=0; this basis is a project choice, not a reproduction of the paper

papers.title: 3D Character Reconstruction from Hand-drawn Model Sheets
papers.idea: Separate shared 3D geometry from per-view screen correspondence corrections
papers.adaptation: Keep authored 3D geometry and constrain the residual chart with discrete CR energy. This linear conformal regularizer is a project adaptation, not the full mesh/Jacobian reconstruction pipeline
papers.codeReuse: No code copied; official repository root has no license file in the inspected main tree

papers.title: Inverse Rig Optimization from Line Drawings
papers.idea: Screen-space contour-normal loss and controlled rig deviation (§3.5)
papers.adaptation: Retain the existing normal-distance loss, attenuate lower/steep silhouette samples as a visibility confidence heuristic; y/slope weights are project-specific, not learned occlusion or surface-normal estimation

papers.title: View-Dependent Deformation Fields for 2D Editing of 3D Models
papers.idea: Smooth, view-dependent 2D corrections lifted/composed over existing geometry
papers.adaptation: Smooth neutral-yaw interpolation and independent 60..88 degree support fade; keep the existing additive residual rather than introducing compositional 3D deformation layers

applied: C1 trigonometric yaw weights through zero; cardinal nine keys unchanged; smoothstep fade from 60 to 88 degrees isolates profile parts
Silhouette confidence: 1.25 at y<=220, 0.55 at 260..360, otherwise 0.85; divide by 1+0.5*slope^2

Area-weighted cell-center Cauchy-Riemann energy on (160*s,restY) pixels (lambda=0.5); mirror coupling between diagonal charts (lambda=0.2); weak adjacent-yaw chart prior (lambda=0.05) also predicts neutral LOPO
Separate pin, held-out normal-observation prediction, raster error, sampled Jacobians, neutral-yaw derivatives and actual WebGL sweep

deferred.item: POSTECH full 3D mesh reconstruction and ray deformation pipeline
deferred.reason: Would replace the approved authored 3D prior, topology and texture workflow; residual chart improvements meet the present scope
The existing linear normal-equation solve is directly differentiable and small; training a surrogate adds approximation error and dependencies

deferred.item: Fixed contour vertex IDs at +/-90 degrees
deferred.reason: Visible silhouette identities change with occlusion and dedicated profile parts; preserve the existing measured profile path
Discrete CR penalizes shear/anisotropic scale with a single linear solve; it permits uniform scale and rotation, so it is documented as conformal rather than equated to ARAP

limitations: Twelve unobserved angle combinations have no independent reference drawings; their metrics measure orientation, conformal distortion and mirror consistency, not held-out image accuracy
LOPO evaluates normal-distance observations on a fixed prior-visible domain; it is separate from the actual raster acceptance metric
The unchanged shared 3D prior and face fit were calibrated from all original drawings. LOPO here withholds residual-chart observations, not every upstream drawing-derived asset
C1 is guaranteed through yaw=0; the existing clamp at +/-45 remains. Support fading is C1 at 60 and 88
Conformal energy at intermediate views can increase while raster error and symmetry improve; report measured before/after values without using this diagnostic as a fitted success claim

selection.discarded: Uniform regularizer scale per pitch triplet: raster mean 37.359px exceeded main 37.281px
selection.adopted: Pose-specific budget multipliers with the same conformal, symmetry and view coefficients; no raster-driven hyperparameter grid search
selection.units: du in pixels; chart x=160*s; CR rows area weighted; symmetry/view sum squared chart-node displacement

definitions.hair: local residual tangent chart (s + dx/h_cell, y + dy), 11x15 cells, nine derivative samples/cell; Jacobian excludes 3D silhouette foreshortening
definitions.conformalEnergy: mean squared Cauchy-Riemann residual of pixel-coordinate Jacobian
definitions.face: actual skin XY triangle Jacobian relative to rest mesh; identical before/after
definitions.mirrorRms: RMS of mirrored screen displacements; original asymmetric artwork can have nonzero error
definitions.sweep: 219 numeric poses, yaw -90..90 step2.5 at pitch -15/0/15; sampled continuity and orientation, not a global injectivity proof

main.definition: actual raster RMS in pixels: head L/R spans at y80..400 step20, topY, and hairline columns step12; fixed reference/prior-visible domain

after.definition: actual raster RMS in pixels: head L/R spans at y80..400 step20, topY, and hairline columns step12; fixed reference/prior-visible domain

hair.definition: identical raster observations with each model own basis (old y584 / split y545)
hair.heldOutPolicy: held-out pose data excluded from joint fit

raster.definition: actual raster RMS in pixels: head L/R spans at y80..400 step20, topY, and hairline columns step12; fixed reference/prior-visible domain

chart.definition: residual-only local tangent chart (s + dx/h0_cell, restY + dy), 11x15 cells, 9 derivative samples/cell; cell half-width extended from the first authored section y60 above the pole; 3D silhouette projection excluded

lower.definition: all four tail mesh XY triangles relative to unchanged pendulum; 45 key/intermediate/profile poses

upper.definition: crown | face only, row spans80..520 step20 + topY + hairline

lower.definition: separate left/right tails | ties, fixed rows550..720 step10

bareFace.definition: alpha-supported bare skin with every hair mesh absent; same frozen face, UV atlas, triangle culling and canvas frame; positive gap cannot be exposed by moving hair alone

remainingEvidence.decision: Approved 20.48px candidate: down-left hairline becomes measurable with median 2px; the 19.54px candidate lost all visible skin at row330. Preserve all reference pixels and formulas; other crown/exterior fitting residuals remain explicit.

webgl.definition: same WebGL full portraits, frozen motion, scale=1, 720x720 crop resized equally to 320x320; rows main/after for each group of five angles
